form.label: 8. Swiss Data Residency & Cloud Compliance
form.description: Prove, on every cloud egress, that "processed in Switzerland" actually held — instead of assuming it did.

html.blockquote: "Solange es in der Schweiz verarbeitet wird, darf es auch in die Cloud raus."
html.p: This is a policy statement, not (yet) a monitored control — the rule is that data may leave to the cloud as long as it was processed within Switzerland first, but today there's no automated evidence that every export actually respected that. Splunk's role here isn't to enforce the policy (a CASB/DLP/cloud gateway does that) — it's to be the audit trail that proves every egress happened after CH-region processing, and to flag the one that didn't before an auditor or regulator finds it.

panel.title: Data sources needed to build this for real

ul.li: Proxy / CASB logs — every outbound request to a cloud service, with destination and (ideally) the cloud region it landed in.
Data classification / DLP tags — which data category (e.g. patient data, internal, public) was in the payload, from the DLP engine or app-level tagging.
Cloud provider audit logs — Azure Activity Log / AWS CloudTrail / GCP Audit Logs, which record the region a resource or processing job actually ran in.
Egress firewall / SASE logs — the network-layer record of what left the Swiss network boundary and when.

search.query: | makeresults count=24 | streamstats count as i | eval Hour=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(24-i)."h"), "%H:00") | eval "Switzerland"=70+(i%10) | eval "Other region (flagged)"=if(i=15,4,0) | table Hour "Switzerland" "Other region (flagged)"

panel.title: Example: cloud egress events by processing region and classification

search.query: | makeresults count=5 | streamstats count as i | eval Time=strftime(relative_time(now(), "-".(300-i*30)."m"), "%H:%M") | eval Application=case(i=1,"Imaging-AI-Pipeline",i=2,"HR-Analytics",i=3,"Imaging-AI-Pipeline",i=4,"Backup-Sync",i=5,"Imaging-AI-Pipeline") | eval "Processed in"=case(i=1,"Switzerland (CH-North)",i=2,"Switzerland (CH-North)",i=3,"Switzerland (CH-North)",i=4,"Switzerland (CH-North)",i=5,"West Europe (Ireland) — POLICY VIOLATION") | eval "Data classification"=case(i=1,"Patient data (pseudonymized)",i=2,"Internal (HR)",i=3,"Patient data (pseudonymized)",i=4,"Internal backups",i=5,"Patient data (pseudonymized)") | eval "Cloud destination"=case(i=1,"Azure Blob (CH-North)",i=2,"Azure Blob (CH-North)",i=3,"Azure Blob (CH-North)",i=4,"Azure Blob (CH-North)",i=5,"Azure Blob (West Europe)") | eval Status=if(i=5,"VIOLATION","OK") | table Time Application "Processed in" "Data classification" "Cloud destination" Status | sort Time

panel.title: The SPL, once proxy/CASB + cloud audit logs are onboarded

html.pre: index=casb_logs action=egress dest_type=cloud | lookup dlp_classification request_id OUTPUT data_class | lookup processing_jobs request_id OUTPUT processed_region | eval violation=if(processed_region!="CH" AND match(data_class,"(?i)patient|phi"), 1, 0) | where violation=1 | table _time app request_id data_class processed_region dest_region
html.p: This becomes a real-time alert (any violation=1 in the last 5 minutes) plus a scheduled compliance report for audit season — evidence instead of a policy statement.
